items.reason: A gentle, fragrance-free-style daily cleanser with no active ingredients is a simple, kind way for a young person to start washing their face.
A mineral SPF 50 fluid is an easy daytime step to protect skin from the sun, and it is gentle on young skin.

response.routine_note: Wash your face gently with lukewarm water once or twice a day, morning and evening, and pat dry. Use the sunscreen in the morning on days you'll be outside, and ask a parent or guardian to help you choose any extra products later.</br>
